notes.title: BIG CHANGES- Patch Notes 5.0
notes.notes:
Game now saves your settings and your puzzles in menu so if you get stuck you can come back later and see what you have solved and continue from there. 
Menu now has glowing icons that help remind the player to checkout the full details of the menu( goes away on click). 
Menu has appropriate resume, quit and restart options. 
Menu is easier to click through pages(collider updated)
Keycard puzzle updated to make slightly easier. 
Particle system updated 
notebook image updated
achievements updated(slightly longer and say different things) 
Updated numbered notes in boss office bookshelf
Height spawn settings updated with an additional wider range and a height reference on the door to match your height to the expected default game height. 
End game updated to have your character in the end game as you watch the credits in the heavens.
Menu sounds, cabinet grab, desk grab and door grab sounds updated. 
Fullscreen changed to Maximize Window.

notes.title: Small Patch Update
notes.notes:
Menu is now available on left hand wrist  as well(for steam players).
Some teleport zones updated 
Sounds for notebook 
achievement notifications updated

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.0
notes.notes: Changes- Graphics updates 2x resolution, Hints updated now linked to objects and more clear, sounds like footsteps, keyboards and player sounds more updated. Changed textures of some items in game. Most controllers are now usable like HTC VIVE etc. Particles on story items are updated. Marker is now alot smoother and easy to use.  Cup in bosses office changed. Lots of other small things updated.
